name: MediaFormat
description: Contains methods and properties that allow access to and control over audio and video media.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Volume
properties.description: Gets or sets the volume of the media. Read/write.

properties.name: Muted
properties.description: Returns whether audio playback of the media is muted. Read/write

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Returns the total length of the media in milliseconds. Read-only.

properties.name: StartPoint
properties.description: Gets or sets the start point of the trim region. Read/write.

properties.name: EndPoint
properties.description: Gets or sets the time of the end point of the trim region of the media. Read/write.

properties.name: FadeInDuration
properties.description: Gets or sets the duration of the fade in of the media, in milliseconds. Read/write.

properties.name: FadeOutDuration
properties.description: Gets or sets the duration of the fadeout of the media, in milliseconds. Read/write.

properties.name: MediaBookmarks
properties.description: Returns a MediaBookmarks collection that represents the media bookmarks associated with the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ResamplingStatus
properties.description: Returns the resampling task status. Read-only.

properties.name: IsLinked
properties.description: Returns whether the media file is linked. Read-only.

properties.name: IsEmbedded
properties.description: Returns whether the media file is embedded. Read-only.

properties.name: AudioSamplingRate
properties.description: Returns the audio sampling rate per second for the media. Read-only.

properties.name: VideoFrameRate
properties.description: Returns the video frame rate per second of the media. Read-only.

properties.name: SampleHeight
properties.description: Returns the resolution height of the sample media. Read-only.

properties.name: SampleWidth
properties.description: Returns the resolution width of the media sample. Read-only.

properties.name: VideoCompressionType
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the video compression format of the media. Read-only.

properties.name: AudioCompressionType
properties.description: Returns the audio compression format. Read-only.

methods.name: SetDisplayPicture
methods.description: Sets the display picture at the specified time position.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The time position in the media to set the display picture.

methods.name: SetDisplayPictureFromFile
methods.description: Sets the display picture from a picture file.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: The path to the display picture file.

methods.name: Resample
methods.signature: Resample([Trim As Boolean], [SampleHeight As Long], [SampleWidth As Long], [VideoFrameRate As Long], [AudioSamplingRate As Long], [VideoBitRate As Long])
methods.description: Adds the current media object to the queue and begins resampling, based on the specified parameters.

parameters.name: VideoFrameRate
parameters.description: The video frame rate, in frames per second.

parameters.name: AudioSamplingRate
parameters.description: The audio sampling rate, in bits per second.

parameters.name: VideoBitRate
parameters.description: The video bit rate, in bits per second.

methods.name: ResampleFromProfile
methods.description: Adds the current media object to the queue and begins resampling base on the specified profile.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The resample media profile to use.
